title: Unshifted Kummer reduction with its positive boundary adjunct
statement: Let l be prime, T a scheme with l invertible in global sections, k the Kummer short exact sequence of [def-sp-tower-class-systems], and r any Reduction [def-sp-tower-class-reduction] for the actual ring system Rrings of [def-sp-tower-class-coefficients]. There are an Rrings-module system M, an isomorphism i from its underlying abelian tower to roots l T, and an isomorphism a from r applied to degree-zero units to M[1]. The adjunct of a, followed by the forgetful shift comparison, the shifted single comparison and i[1], equals k.exact.singleδ. This asserts only the unshifted target comparison; the integer source and the shift from degree one to degree two are absent.

proof.text: Apply the variable-power reduction triangle to k.power and its prescribed components. Its second arrow is the actual unit of the supplied derived adjunction, and its first arrow is single(k.power).

source.place: clause (2), simultaneous reduction; triangle and cohomology realization

proof.text: Rotate the distinguished single triangle of the supplied Kummer short exact sequence once. Its first map is also single(k.power) and its second map is the positive boundary k.exact.singleδ. Complete the identity square on the first two objects to a morphism of distinguished triangles. The triangulated five lemma makes its third map e an isomorphism from the underlying derived reduction to roots[1], with unit followed by e equal to the positive Kummer boundary. This is the proved helper boundary_comparison; no equality is inferred by levelwise evaluation.

source.place: clause (2), simultaneous reduction; triangle and cohomology realization

proof.text: The section and morphism prescriptions make r.forget.F faithful, as proved by forget_faithful. Its exact derived functor reflects concentration in degree -1. The isomorphism e therefore makes the actual Rrings-linear reduction pure of degree -1. The existing derived-category single-object representation supplies M and a: reduction ≅ M[1]. Form q by the inverse canonical forgetful shift/single comparisons, the inverse image of a, and e. The shifted degree-zero single functor on abelian towers is fully faithful, so q uniquely comes from an abelian-tower isomorphism i:forget(M) ≅ roots. Its preimage equation gives forget(a) followed by the canonical comparisons and i[1] equal to e. These steps are all proved in lift_shifted_single, with no full faithfulness assertion about derived forgetting.

proof.text: Expand the derived-adjunction homEquiv as its unit followed by the forgetful image. Substitute the equation of lift_shifted_single and then the unit-boundary equation of boundary_comparison. The resulting equality is exactly the statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_kummerReductionUnit (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (k : Kummer l T)
    (r : Reduction T (Rrings l T)) :
    ∃ (M : Systems T (Rrings l T)) (i : r.forget.F.obj M ≅ roots l T)
      (a : r.derived.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).obj (units T)) ≅
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      (r.derivedAdjunction.homEquiv _ _) a.hom ≫
        (r.forget.F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj M) ≫
        ((r.forget.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Ab T) 0).map i.hom)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
          k.exact.singleδ
